Class ShadowIsoDep

java.lang.Object
org.robolectric.shadows.ShadowBasicTagTechnology
org.robolectric.shadows.ShadowIsoDep
@Implements(IsoDep.class) public class ShadowIsoDep extends ShadowBasicTagTechnology
Extends IsoDep to allow for testing.

Control the allowed packet size with setExtendedLengthApduSupported(boolean) and setMaxTransceiveLength(int). Note that extended Apdu packets have a max transceive length of 0x10008 but most hardware implementations will have a lower limit. If extended length apdus are not supported, the theoretical max transceive length is 0x105 but, again, may be lower in practice.

Dictate the Apdu response returned in transceive(byte[]) via setTransceiveResponseQueue(Queue), setTransceiveResponse(byte[]), or setNextTransceiveResponse(byte[]). setTransceiveResponse(byte[]) will be returned with every call to transceive while setNextTransceiveResponse(byte[]) will be returned only once. If a queue is set via setTransceiveResponseQueue(Queue), responses are polled in order and a null entry throws an IOException. If none is set, transceive will throw an IOException.
